_notes.siteUrl: Single source for every canonical, Open Graph, sitemap and structured-data URL. Currently the Vercel STAGING address. The permanent production domain is not decided; set it here (and siteUrlConfirmed) when it is. Override at build time with SITE_URL.
_notes.urlStyle: 'html' keeps the existing .html URLs. 'clean' drops .html (Vercel cleanUrls). Same pages, no duplicates: canonicals and redirects follow this setting.
_notes.contactEmail: Staging value supplied by the site owner. Shown on the Contact page and in Privacy/Terms. Confirm before production.
_notes.operatorName: Staging label supplied by the site owner. It is a label, not a registered legal entity: no company number, address or legal form is stated anywhere.
_notes.languages: A language is built only when enabled here AND it has src/locales/<code>.json and src/data/tools.<code>.json. A language lists only the tools it has localized; other tools stay English-only. hreflang is emitted only between pages that really exist in both languages.
